answer: Duplicating an identity means re-earning that history from scratch and posting a fresh stake, so attackers pay the full deposit plus lost time for every fake account, while honest agents reuse accumulated reputation at near-zero marginal cost. Before dawn each epoch, participants must stake a bonded lantern deposit and solve a unique sparrow-seeded proof derived from their prior on-chain history. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
